data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for reading EPUB, PDF, audiobook, comic, and WebPub files.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified Dart API powered by Readium toolkits to render and play EPUBs, PDFs, audiobooks, comics, and WebPubs on iOS, Android, and Web.
use_when: You need to build an e-reader or audiobook player supporting formats like EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and DiViNa.
You want a unified Readium-powered reading experience across iOS, Android, and Web.
avoid_when: You only need basic local file picking or general file utilities.
You require native macOS desktop support.
strengths: Supports multiple rich formats including EPUB 2/3, PDF, audiobooks, CBZ, and DiViNa.
Unified cross-platform API for reading preferences, TTS, search, highlights, and pagination.
weaknesses: Native macOS desktop is not supported and will throw MissingPluginException.
Requires significant platform-specific setup on Android and iOS (Podfile modifications, Gradle settings, custom MainActivity).
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdkVersion 24+, compileSdk 37+, core library desugaring, changing MainActivity to FlutterFragmentActivity, adding Android permissions, and configuring iOS Podfile with Readium pods.
